text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It's all right, no need to be so nervous♪ 
Shall we begin, then?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"The Birthday Girl Project"! A total 
makeover to help you become a whole new 
you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
P-Please do! For today, I got a hair 
treatment at the salon... and I even went 
on a diet!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's just stuff like cutting back 
on sweets, but still...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Wonderful! You kept up your steady 
effort... Today's Yukino-chan is even 
prettier than yesterdayâª

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I prepared a few different options, 
but... with the way you are right now, 
Yukino-chan, I really want you to take on 
the high-class style!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
That dream brand Gold City-chan modeled 
for... I was able to lease an outfit from 
them! I picked out a look that feels just 
like Yukino-chan♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Speaking as the birthday girl herself, how 
does it feel?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Gh! Speaking as the birthday girl... 
P-Pretty please!"
